title: The orphan pass and ingest define a thread's record files two ways
body:
Found by ST0096's catch-up critics (vc, 2026-11-22, refs/bank/vc/st0096/close-H1-* and close-H3-*). Fixed under hv decision 86 in cc's d86c for 3.5.1.

Facade::orphaned_records (facade.rs about 15904) walks a thread's records directory with Project::files_in, which honours .gitignore and drops walk errors, while ingest's collect_record_paths (ingest.rs about 977) reads every record file and surfaces an unreadable directory. A record file under an ignored name is read by ingest and never removed by the orphan pass, and a walk error is silent. Expected: one walker, errors surfaced.
